item.description: Rockstar Games co-founder Dan Houser, who departed the company in 2020, stated in a recent interview with Variety that he has not watched Grand Theft Auto 6’s extended reveal. item.title: Miami Heat to Host 'A Night in Vice City' GTA 6 Themed Game Before Launch
item.description: The Miami Heat will rebrand as Vice City for one night on November 18, wearing GTA 6-inspired jerseys and playing on a themed court at the Kaseya Center against the Milwaukee Bucks. The event, airing on ESPN, is part of a partnership with Rockstar Games ahead of GTA 6's release on November 19.

item.title: GTA 6 Aims to Amplify Real World with 'Over the Top' Experience, GameSpot Reports
item.description: GameSpot reports that Rockstar Games intends Grand Theft Auto 6 to reflect and amplify the current world with an "over the top" experience, per senior VP of narrative Rupert Humphries speaking to Love Magazine. The piece details dual protagonists Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, described as vulnerabl

item.title: GTA 6 x Miami Heat Rebrand As Vice City For Release Day Event
item.description: Rockstar Games and the Miami Heat have announced a 'Night in Vice City' collaboration, with the NBA franchise temporarily rebranding for a game on the eve of GTA VI's launch.

item.title: RockstarINTEL Lists GTA Online Ghost Exposed 2026 Ghost Locations and Rewards
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games brought back the GTA Online Ghost Exposed collectible event for Halloween 2026, with 10 ghost locations, Snapmatic photo rewards, and the Ghosts Exposed Jacket.

item.title: Rockstar Announces GTA Online Halloween Content for October 2026
item.description: Rockstar Games published a news feed item confirming Halloween-themed content will run throughout October in GTA Online, but the full details of the seasonal event have not been released.

item.title: GTA 6 Had A Really Busy Week
item.description: With less than 50 days until launch, GTA 6's marketing push ramps up: Love Magazine's Jason and Lucia cover, a Brooklyn mural spotting, Rockstar merch, and a Miami Heat takeover.

item.title: GTA 6 Screenshots and Story Details Revealed in LOVE Magazine
item.description: New Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots and narrative insights have been published via LOVE magazine issue 27, featuring interviews with Rockstar developers and writers.

item.title: Warhorse Co-Founder Hopes GTA 6 Will 'Blaze a Trail' to Higher Game Prices
item.description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance studio co-founder Martin Klima tells PC Gamer he hopes Grand Theft Auto 6 will lead the industry toward higher game prices as development costs rise.

item.title: GTA 6's Weather System Sounds Like A Big Step Up
item.description: Rockstar's Owen Shepherd told Game Informer that Grand Theft Auto 6 features a re-engineered weather system with localized rain, dynamic cloudscapes, new wind effects, and tropical storms, with gameplay impacts still unknown.

item.title: GTA 6 Doesn't Compromise Scale For Detail, Rockstar Says
item.description: Rockstar's Aaron Garbut tells Game Informer the studio dialed up detail, scope, breadth, scale, interaction, and density for GTA 6 rather than trading one for another, ahead of the game's November 19 launch.

item.title: Alleged Rockstar Games Hacker Arrested, FBI Says He Led ShinyHunters
item.description: Dutch police arrested a 24-year-old Amsterdam man on suspicion of involvement with the hacking group ShinyHunters, which breached Rockstar Games earlier this year and leaked GTA Online financial data. The FBI alleges he was one of the group's leaders.

item.title: Modder who taunted ‘try me Rockstar’ with GTA 5 Switch port is ‘thankful for Take-Two’s mercy’ as lawyers shut it down
item.description: A modder known as Mojso has shut down an unofficial Grand Theft Auto 5 Switch port after receiving a legal notice from Take-Two. The project, which also aimed to bring GTA Online to the console, was taken down after the modder taunted Rockstar with a 'try me' post. Mojso said they are 'thankful for

item.title: GTA 6 map is twice the size of GTA 5, features hurricanes and tropical storms, Rockstar confirms
item.description: Rockstar has confirmed GTA 6's map is the largest it has ever created 'by some degree,' twice as large as GTA 5, with a new localized weather system that includes tropical storms and hurricanes.

item.title: Dutch Police Arrest Suspect in ShinyHunters Investigation
item.description: Dutch police say they arrested a man suspected of involvement with ShinyHunters, the group that claimed an earlier Rockstar Games breach. The arrest and separate murder solicitation allegation remain under investigation.

item.title: GTA 6 Won’t Spoof Disney World, Says Rockstar – Here’s What We Know
item.description: GameSpot reports that GTA 6 won't include a parody of Walt Disney World or other Central Florida landmarks, per Rockstar's Jack McPherson. The game still aims for the 'full Florida experience' elsewhere.

item.title: GTA 6 Fans Hope for GTA 4-Style NPC Physics
item.description: A Reddit post sparking nostalgia for GTA 4's Euphoria physics engine has fans hoping GTA 6 will let them 'bully' NPCs like the 2008 classic.

item.title: Fan Art Blends GTA 3 Style with GTA 6 Setting, Posted on Reddit
item.description: A Reddit user named THE_SURMENKO shared artwork inspired by GTA 3's aesthetic applied to GTA 6. The post, published on September 16, 2026, appears to be a fan creation, but details beyond the title are limited.

item.title: Reddit Thread Sparks Zelda Remake vs. GTA 6 Discourse Debate
item.description: A Reddit post highlights the ongoing fan discourse comparing a Zelda remake against GTA 6. The thread's exact arguments remain unclear, but it underscores the passionate—and sometimes heated—community discussions surrounding Rockstar's anticipated title.

item.title: Reddit Post Dings 'Rockstar Games Logic' — But Details Are Thin
item.description: A Reddit post titled 'Rockstar Games logic 😭' surfaced this week, but the feed lacks context. Here's what we know — and what remains unclear.

item.title: GTA 6 Single-Player Confirmed, GTA Online Continues, PC Release Possibly Closer – Reddit Report
item.description: A Reddit report on today's investor call suggests GTA 6 will be single-player, GTA Online will keep running, and a PC version might arrive sooner than expected.

item.title: GTA VI Online Called a ‘Strictly Guarded Secret’ as Report Claims Developer Protection From Drones and Hackers
item.description: A new report from ixbt.games says GTA VI Online is being kept under tight wraps, with developers reportedly protected from drones and hacker attacks. Details remain scarce and unconfirmed.

item.title: Rockstar Compares GTA 6 Secrecy to Apple’s iPhone and Coca-Cola’s Formula
item.description: Rockstar Games reportedly likens its strict protection of GTA 6 details to how Apple guards the iPhone and Coca-Cola protects its secret recipe, according to IGN.

item.title: New GTA 6 Online Leak Claims 32-Player Lobbies and ‘Top Secret’ Status at Rockstar
item.description: A fresh leak from EGW.News alleges GTA 6 Online will feature 32-player lobbies and is being treated as 'top secret' at Rockstar Games. The report remains unverified.

item.title: GTA 6 Online Reportedly Supports 32 Players, According to Lawsuit Documents
item.description: GTA 6 Online may support up to 32 players, per a report from Korean outlet 게임메카 citing lawsuit documents. Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed.

item.title: GTA 6 Collaborations Teased by Travis Scott, Future, Keith Richards - Report
item.description: Notebookcheck reports that several high-profile musicians have shared teasers for GTA 6 collaborations. Details are scarce, but the hints point to a star-studded soundtrack.

item.title: Take-Two CEO Says GTA 6 Extended Look Had a 'Tutorial' Element
item.description: Sportskeeda reports that Take-Two's CEO described the GTA 6 extended look as containing a baked-in tutorial element. Details remain sparse, but the comment hints at a more guided introduction.

item.title: GTA VI: The Album Reportedly Coming November 19 with 34 Original Tracks
item.description: A Reddit post reports that Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album will release on November 19, featuring 34 original tracks tied to Vice City and Leonida. The report remains unconfirmed by Rockstar or Take-Two.

item.title: Huge 192 GB Rockstar Leak Reported, But It's Not GTA 6
item.description: Notebookcheck reports a massive 192 GB Rockstar leak surfacing two months before GTA 6's release, yet the content allegedly has little to do with the upcoming game. Details remain sparse.

item.title: Massive GTA 5 Leak Reportedly Reveals Scrapped Liberty City DLC and Early GTA 6 Files
item.description: A new 200GB GTA 5 source code leak, reported by Eurogamer, suggests Rockstar Games scrapped a Liberty City DLC and includes very early GTA 6 work.
